questions.stem: Which of the following statements regarding treatments for Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is correct?

options.label: A
options.text: Early Start Denver Model (ESDM) primarily focuses on role-play activity for children with ASD.

options.label: B
options.text: Social Skills Training involves only individual therapy sessions where children practice social skills face-to-face with a therapist.

options.label: C
options.text: Treatment and Education of Autistic and Communication-Related Handicapped Children (TEACCH) employs structured teaching methods to support learning in children with ASD.

options.label: D
options.text: Pivotal Response Training emphasizes the use of pharmacological interventions to enhance communication skills in children with ASD.
